# OUTPUT NAME

Name the output document that gets the tables.

## Syntax

```text
OUTPUT NAME [NAME=]name.
```

The designated document (the one that gets the tables) takes the name, and a document that had it gets a new one. Without any document yet, an empty one is started.

## Example

```text
OUTPUT NAME men.
```

`statscraft help OUTPUT NAME` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
